4420.title: External plugin file references survive export without their files
4420.rootCauseOneLine: Database snapshot retains path-valued settings while inventory exports only server-owned roots and emits no reference warning.
4420.proposedFix: Explicit server-file metadata, migration preflight checklist and tested internal-path rebasing; controlled external-file transfer only.
caveats: Actual export/extraction tested twice; full move/CLI preflight/import reconciliation not exercised.
Source disappearance simulated by deleting only an owned synthetic file.
